messages:
Sam (PM): Quick sync — as we get close to the v2 API flip (target: Fri EOD), we need clear owners for SDK changes, compatibility tests, and deprecation notes. TL;DR: assign owners, confirm canary windows, list any blocking deps. Reply with owner + 1-line blocker please.

Alice: I can own backend compatibility tests + migration checklist. Blocker: the alpha route renames one of the response fields (GQL -> REST shim) — need example responses.

Ben: I’ll take iOS (Swift) SDK. Question: v2 changes streaming framing — do we have a spec? @Alice can you drop the contract doc? :eyes: 

Carla: I’ll own Python SDK. PR ready: https://github.internal/redwood/python-sdk/pull/432 — needs CI infra update for new header `x-rw-client`.

Dan: I’ll own JS/TS SDK. Plan is to ship feature flag `use_v2` + a compatibility proxy. Will open PR today and ping for reviews.

Emma: Runtime note — v2 defaults to chunked/event streaming for chat. SDKs need to handle chunked partial json objects; prefer graceful fallback to v1 behaviour if client sends `Accept: application/json`. Also blocker: KV cache infra upgrade scheduled Wed could affect latency-sensitive tails.

Liu: Infra/canary availability: dedicated canary window booked Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC (low traffic). Staging will get rate-limit config changes Mon. If you need higher qps for tests, DM me so I can bump the quota.

Alice: For deprecation docs we need concrete before/after examples. Carla/Dan — can you paste a minimal failing snippet you expect consumers to hit?

Carla: Example diff consumers will see: ```json
- { "message": "hello" }
+ { "content": { "text": "hello" } }
``` 
This breaks the `resp["message"]` access pattern.

Ben: iOS streaming change is small — switching to incremental JSON assembly. Will open PR later today: https://github.internal/redwood/ios-sdk/pull/77. Ping me for CRs. :+1:

Dan: TS PR is up: https://github.internal/redwood/js-sdk/pull/210 — adds `compat/v1` fallback and feature flag. Tests failing on Node 16 due to a stream polyfill; investigating.

Emma: Also flagging model routing: v2 default route uses r12 models. Dedicated customers must have explicit model pins in their configs to avoid unexpected changes. Internal KB: https://intranet.redwood/ops/routing-v2 (internal link).

Sam (PM): Summaries — owners: Alice (compat tests + deprecations), Ben (iOS), Carla (Python), Dan (TS), Emma (runtime), Liu (infra). I’ll update the project board. Action items: owners post PRs by Tue EOD or highlight blockers here. :white_check_mark:

InfraBot: Canary deploy scheduled: app-redwood-v2-canary -> staging at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z

DeployBot: Canary run passed basic smoke checks (3/3).

Ben: @Dan can you review the iOS PR when you have a sec? small SSE/SSE->SSE-JSON change :pray:

Dan: On it, ETA ~3h.

Sam (PM): Thanks all — I’ll follow up in the board and drop a short note in #announcements before the canary. If anything blocks PRs, call it out here so we can escalate.
